summary: Split the full CI Storybook play matrix across four shards instead of two, leaving room for shard 0's other web checks within the unchanged 25-minute job timeout.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CI-only change. Full runs retain every story, width, theme, accessibility assertion and exact receipt coverage check. Pull requests keep the unsharded per-commit set.

recovery.detail: Revert to restore the two-shard full matrix.
